messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're kicking off the rollout of tokenless self-hosted GitHub Actions runners (OIDC-based identity) this Friday 2026-03-14. Goal: remove long-lived PATs from runner auth. We'll flip cohorts 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Details below.
aj: Quick q — does this affect all org-owned runners or just the self-hosted pool?
maria: Only self-hosted runners (infra-*, ml-*, platform-* repos) in phase 1. Hosted runners are unaffected. :sparkles: 
samir: What's the concrete action item for repo owners?
maria: Update workflows that provision runner-level PATs. New recommended pattern is to use id-token and short-lived role assumption. Example snippet:```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Request identity token
        id: identity
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: return core.getIDToken()
      - name: Assume role with web identity
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-runner
          web-identity-token-file: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.token }}
```
olivia: Will the runner image change? We have custom images that call `gh auth login` with a PAT today.
maria: Runners will inject an ephemeral identity token at `/var/run/oidc/token` and set `RUNNER_OIDC=true`. We'll publish a tiny shim (script/image) to adapt legacy flows. Please avoid `gh auth login` with PATs going forward.
aj: What's the plan for secret rotation for existing PATs?
security-bot: Security update: onboarding PATs used by runners will be revoked after cutover. Timeline: rotate PAT inventory on 2026-03-17, disable legacy token auth on 2026-03-21 00:00 UTC. If you rely on PATs, migrate before that window or request a postponement.
samir: Is there an opt-in for canary? Need to coordinate with infra owners.
maria: Repo owners in cohort A will receive opt-in invites tomorrow. Canary will run on infra-* cohort for 48h, then expand if no regressions. We'll monitor CI success rate, runner heartbeats, and deploy failures; status posted to #release-war-room.
olivia: What about third-party actions that assume PAT?
maria: If an action uses `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` it still works. Breakage only happens for flows that use runner-level PATs. Please report specific action names in this thread and we'll evaluate shims or adjustments.
aj: Can we get the shim earlier to test locally?
deploy-bot: [deploy] Published `redwood/runners/oidc-shim:0.3` to the internal registry. Use `--platform multiarch` image or the dockerfile in the repo.
maria: Thanks @deploy-bot. Next steps: read the migration doc <https://internal.redwood.com/docs/runner-oidc-migration|migration doc>, test shim in a fork, and join office hours on Thursday 16:00 UTC if you need help. Ping me with repos that must be postponed. :rocket:
